headline: How to get Xenolord in Palworld
title: How to Get Xenolord in Palworld | Raid Boss Slab Explained | Palworld Guide
video_script: Looking for Xenolord in Palworld? You won't find it walking around the map. Xenolord is a raid boss. To fight it, collect four Xenolord Slab Fragments. They drop from Feybreak dungeons and from Feybreak expeditions at the Pal Expedition Station. Combine the four fragments into the slab, place it on a Summoning Altar at your base, and the raid begins. Beat it, and you can catch one of the best flying mounts in the game. Ready for the raid? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Place the slab at your base
